question: Choose the correct one word substitution for:** "The fear of open or public spaces."**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Agoraphobia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Agoraphobia"** refers to an intense fear of open or public spaces. It is a type of anxiety disorder where individuals avoid situations or environments where they feel trapped or helpless. (खुले या सार्वजनिक स्थानों का डर)
 
 
• **Example:** Due to her agoraphobia, she avoided going to crowded malls and large gatherings.
 
 
 
• People with this condition often feel overwhelmed in large, open areas or places with many people, such as shopping centers or public transportation.
